prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: ONE genuine NE directional IDLE source view of the SAME retained construction robot model16.
Input1 is the approved exact E-side model: front RIGHT, one rear nozzle LEFT. Input2 is the corrected genuine N rear view: front and navy display UP/far, single rear nozzle DOWN/near. Orbit this one physical rig to the intermediate NE camera, halfway between those two. The robot FRONT points UP-RIGHT/away; its ONE rear nozzle points DOWN-LEFT toward camera, with its open mouth at the NEAR LOWER-LEFT. The original flat navy roof display is toward the FAR UPPER-RIGHT/FRONT. Both folded arms turn with the hull; closed wrists near the FAR front/upper-right, shoulders toward rear/lower-left. Exactly2arms,2closed two-jaw wrists total, naturally occluded, never a second pair. The small passive front coupling is far upper-right and may be partially hidden. No extra nozzle/stub at the far front.
Preserve the exact broad closed pentagonal ivory-ceramic/gunmetal hull and orange joints, one small dark-navy display, compact single rear engine, integral closed lower chassis boss, original arm lengths/idle fold. This is the same cargo-less engineer: no drill/cutter, cargo bed/hopper/crates/materials, working beam, service equipment, lights/exhaust, solar wings, antennas, crew or weapons. Keep ONE rear nozzle only. Show the real rear three-quarter gunmetal faces and changed occlusion. No flat mirror or rotated E artwork.
Fixed LOW elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC camera about26.565degrees above horizontal, upper-left SCREEN light unchanged. Broad squat silhouette with complete projected width:height roughly1.4:1; avoid an overhead elongated roof. Native target64x48, world anchor(-32,-32), same physical scale as accepted views. Crisp detailed volumetric isometric sprite render.
ONE entire complete robot centered on TRUE-TRANSPARENT1024x1024 canvas, target whole body about560x380px, ample clear alpha=0 margins. Single-view fallback NO frames/magenta/colored borders, background, ground plane, cast shadow, haze, checkerboard, text, labels, arrows, watermark or extra views. True NE rear-three-quarter camera: nozzle near LOWER-LEFT, front coupling and dark roof display FAR UPPER-RIGHT.

layout_review.camera: Single rear nozzle near/lower-left, passive front coupling/roof display far/upper-right. Exactly2folded arms, correct rear three-quarter physical side and screen-fixed light.
